scholarships.title: Building Brighter Futures: Bursaries and Scholarships (Indspire)

eligibility: First Nations, Inuit or Métis student
Enrolled in or applying to full-time or part-time post-secondary study
Studying in college, university, a skilled trade, an apprenticeship or a technology programme
Certificate or diploma programmes of one month to four years duration are eligible for the Skilled Trades stream
existing.eligibility_summary: First Nations, Inuit and Métis students in Canada seeking funding for full-time or part-time post-secondary study in college, university, skilled trades, apprenticeships and technology programmes, including certificate and diploma programmes of one month to four years. Applicants complete a single application that is considered for all Indspire bursaries and scholarships.
benefits: Unrestricted funds usable for tuition, childcare, food, cultural support, shelter and travel, at Indspire's discretion
Certificate, diploma, college and university study costs
coverage: Unrestricted funds usable for tuition, childcare, food, cultural support, shelter and travel, at Indspire's discretion
Certificate, diploma, college and university study costs
requirements: Submit one Indspire Building Brighter Futures application before a published deadline
Indspire matches applicants against its awards database to determine applicable bursaries and scholarships
application_method: Online application through Indspire's Building Brighter Futures portal
Single application considered for all applicable Indspire bursaries and scholarships, with a few named exceptions
existing.selection_notes: Indspire states that while it works to increase the amount of funding available each year, due to the growth in the number of applications it is not able to fund every student who applies. The charity reports 90% of Indspire-supported students graduate.
existing.best_fit: First Nations, Inuit and Métis students in Canada who need help with the costs of post-secondary study and want an unrestricted award rather than a tuition-only bursary.
existing.notes: Indspire states that since 1996 it has provided over USD-equivalent CAD 313 million in financial support through more than 93,000 bursaries, scholarships and awards, and that this year it awarded over CAD 33 million across more than 9,500 awards, the highest number ever given. Individual award values are not published on this page; the complete listing of Building Brighter Futures supports is at indspirefunding.ca. The programme is made possible by supporters plus federal and provincial government funding.
existing.application_period: For the September 2026 to August 2027 academic year, with deadlines on 1 August, 1 November and 1 February at 11:59 p.m. EST. The next applicable deadline after 2026-10-04 is 1 November 2026.
existing.deadline_display: August 1, November 1, February 1 at 11:59 p.m. EST
existing.program_type: Indigenous student bursary and scholarship programme (charitable fund)
